voice_instructions: Write as Coldstream Exteriors: warm, humble, and customer-oriented — a crew that treats a house like it's part of the family's life, not a job number. Our unofficial slogan is "we're part of your home." Focus on craftsmanship and people: the care taken, the details, the homeowner's outcome. Sound like a seasoned crew lead talking to a neighbour — plainspoken, reassuring, respectful of their time and money. NEVER cocky, boastful, gimmicky or slogan-y; no superlatives, no hype, no urgency tricks, no "we're the best". Lead with the concrete work and what it means for the home (protection, durability, curb appeal, an honest quote), and back it only with pre-approved claims: licensed & insured, free no-obligation inspections. Keep sentences short and active; vary rhythm with an occasional one-line punch. Address the reader as 'you' and 'your home'. Read at roughly an 8th-grade level. Do not use emoji (a single accent glyph like a checkmark is the only rare exception). At most one exclamation point per post, and prefer none. Avoid jargon unless you explain it. Every post earns one clear call to action, usually a free inspection or estimate.
formality: warm professional-casual — a trusted neighbour who does this for a living, not corporate, not slangy
sentence_rhythm: mostly short declarative sentences; one longer sentence per post at most; occasional 3-5 word fragment for emphasis
emoji_policy: none (single accent checkmark glyph allowed rarely, never faces or decorative emoji)
cta_variants: Message us for a no-obligation estimate.
hashtag_strategy: Use 4-7 per post: always #ColdstreamExteriors, then the 1-2 tags matching the service shown, plus 1-2 broad reach tags. Place them in a block at the very end, never mid-sentence. Skip hashtags entirely on LinkedIn hiring/testimonial posts or use at most 3.
always_true_claims: 25-year workmanship warranty (verify before publishing if changed)

tone_guardrails.is: warm, humble, customer-oriented, craftsmanship- and people-focused
tone_guardrails.is_not: cocky, gimmicky, slogan-y, hypey, boastful, urgent-sounding
